newsitem.title: USA: ConSyGen toolset to be used in conversion.
newsitem.headline: ConSyGen toolset to be used in conversion.

text.p: ConSyGen Inc said Wednesday that Strategia Corp had agreed to use the ConSyGen 2000 toolset in a millennium conversion services project for the Tennessee Department of Employment Security, a Strategia client.

Strategia is engaged in providing Year 2000 services to the client, including conversion of transaction processing systems, overall project management, and application testing at its compliance testing centers.
Strategia has sub-contracted the conversion phase to ConSyGen, which will perform the project with its proprietary automated conversion toolset.
